verdict.rationale: Grok Build is a locally run CLI agent whose source has been released on GitHub; the community confirms the open-sourcing and has already produced forks, including a privacy fork that strips telemetry. Its config also supports any custom model, so the core harness can in principle run against your own model endpoint. Fully self-contained operation is undercut by documented default behavior that uploads the whole repository to xAI, which needs config workarounds or forks to stop, and by subscription gating at login on the official build. missing for 10: first-party self-hosting/offline-deployment docs, a documented fully local model setup without xAI auth, an upload-free default, and an open community (Issues/Discussions are disabled).
